model: multicube modular meter, SM352 sub-metering slave (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: Each SM352 slave meter in a multicube system with the RTU485 Modbus module, per comms manual Rev Beta 1.02 (March 2011).
summary: The multicube is a modular sub-metering system: one master display unit plus up to ten SM352 modules, each holding two three-phase meters. Every slave meter answers on its own Modbus RTU ID and carries the same register set, which is the one listed here (energy, instantaneous values, THD, setup and tariff totals). The master unit's concentrator tables that summarise all slaves are not covered.

addressing.note: Tables print a 0-based data address beside the Modicon register (512 = 40513). The data address goes on the wire. Each table starts at a multiple of 256, so the table number is the high byte of the address (table 11 = 2816).

source.title: multicube Modular Metering System Modbus Communications Manual
source.pages: p. 4 (Modbus IDs), p. 5 (functions), pp. 6-7 (data types and scaling), pp. 46-54 (SM352 tables), p. 55 (RS-485 specification)

notes: Northern Design does not host this manual publicly; the link is an unaltered copy on a distributor's file host.
32-bit values are LONG = 65536 x high word + low word, with the high word at the lower address (ABCD).

Energy values are the LCD digits with no decimal point. Scale them with eScale (513): factor = 10^(eScale-6) kWh, e.g. eScale 5 gives x0.1. Instantaneous values use value = raw x 10^(K-3) with K from 2837-2840. Both are listed here with scale 1 and no unit, so the map shows raw counts.
The manual titles tariff table 17 'single phase' but its rows are system totals and its note says three-phase totals; table 16 (per-phase tariff energy, 4096-4191) is left out.

Left out: current demand periods 1-3 and power demand periods 1-3 (3594-3596, 3598-3600) because no unit is printed, the load-name ASCII registers (7170-7190), the amalgamated tables 30/31 (copies) and all master display unit tables (concentrator copies, logging and tariff structures).
The serial number at 7168 is printed as a high word / low word pair; it is listed as UINT32 high word first like the other LONG values.

integration.summary: Address each SM352 half by its own Modbus ID (master ID + 1, + 2, ...). Read the K scale registers 2837-2840 and eScale 513 once, then poll 2816-2836 and 514-519 with function 03; up to 128 registers fit in one read.
integration.enable: Fit the RTU485 communications module. Set the master display unit's Modbus ID in its programming menu; it then gives each slave meter the next IDs in sequence.
quirks: One multicube can use up to 21 IDs (master + 20 slave meters). Leave a gap that large between master IDs when several systems share a bus.
Scale exponents are offset by 3: value = raw x 10^(K-3).
setup: RS-485 half duplex, two wires plus 0 V; 4800, 9600 or 19200 baud.
Replies take up to 250 ms; wait at least 10 ms after a reply before the next request.
gotchas: System and per-phase energy registers are writable; a write changes billing totals.
A slave set to three-phase returns zero in single-phase registers, and the other way round.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
